tagline: Investing in residential mortgage-backed securities to generate shareholder returns
hero_kpi_rationale: Key indicator of sensitivity to interest rate fluctuations, the primary market risk for a REIT specialized in MBS

kpis.name: Interest Rate Risk Sensitivity
kpis.explanation: Measure of the impact of interest rate changes on net interest income and portfolio value
kpis.description: Sensitivity of net interest income to a 100 basis point increase in interest rates as of December 31, 2025

kpis.name: Mortgage Spread Risk
kpis.explanation: Estimated impact of a 25 basis point change in mortgage spread on portfolio value
kpis.description: Sensitivity of the MBS portfolio to a 25 basis point increase in mortgage spread as of December 31, 2025

kpis.short: Stockholders Equity Sensitivity to Interest Rates
kpis.name: Stockholders' Equity Sensitivity to Interest Rates
kpis.explanation: Impact of interest rate changes on shareholders' equity value
kpis.description: Sensitivity of shareholders' equity to a 100 basis point increase in interest rates as of December 31, 2025

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Interest Rates
risks.score_rationale: Changes in interest rates can significantly impact the company's results, particularly the value of its MBS assets and short-term financing costs. A 100 basis point increase would reduce net interest income by 6.31%.

risks.title: Mortgage Spread Risk
risks.score_rationale: A weakening mortgage market could negatively affect investment performance and market value. A 25 basis point spread widening would reduce portfolio value by 1.16%.

risks.title: Prepayment Risk
risks.score_rationale: Prepayments create volatility in net interest income due to changes in premium amortization or discount accretion.

risks.title: REIT Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company must maintain REIT status and comply with numerous regulatory requirements. Non-compliance could have severe consequences on tax structure.

risks.title: Financing Liquidity
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on short-term repurchase agreement financing. Lender unavailability could force asset sales at depressed prices.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company has implemented governance mechanisms to manage cybersecurity risks, with oversight by the Audit Committee. A breach could impact critical systems and data.

risks.title: Market Volatility from Tariffs
risks.score_rationale: Tariffs introduced in 2025 increased financial market and interest rate volatility, although volatility has since decreased.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies is present in the 10-K filing.
